After crouching for 2+ seconds before standing up:
Grants 15? Handling and ? Reload Speed for ? seconds.

After crouching for 2+ seconds before standing up:
Grants ? Handling and 10 Reload Speed for 5 seconds.

Upon standing up after crouching for 2 seconds:
Grants ? Handling and 10 Reload Speed for 5 seconds.

Upon standing up after crouching for 2 seconds:
Grants 30 Handling, 30 Reload Speed, and 15% Increased Damage to Hive Combatants for 5 seconds.

Upon sliding, or upon standing up after having crouched for 2 seconds:
Grants 30 Handling, 30 Reload Speed, and 15% Increased Damage to Hive Combatants for 5 seconds.
